title: Acceleration Point | ECHO//100 Episode 67
description:
Kavi-Byte battles the chronal winds as the reality-bending child triggers a catastrophic collapse of the timeline. To save the future, Kavi must sacrifice his own physical existence to patch the breach. Episode 67 of ECHO//100: Null Before Null. This is an original work of fiction created with the assistance of AI.

This is original AI-assisted animated fiction.

scenes.text: The garden fractures as Mira’s holographic edges fray, flickering between youth and sudden, ancient decay.
scenes.caption: Mira begins aging rapidly
scenes.image_prompt: Mira with a translucent teal coat flickering between a young girl and an elderly woman in a floating data garden.

scenes.text: Chronal winds scream, tearing data petals into jagged shards while the child wails in pure static.
scenes.caption: Reality begins to collapse
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in his red hoodie shielding a small glowing child from swirling digital debris in a vortex.

scenes.text: Byte glows frantically, scanning the void to reveal a gaping, hungry hole where the battery once lived.
scenes.caption: A void in space
scenes.image_prompt: Byte, a floating white entity with a cyan face and orange antenna, pointing at a dark temporal rift.

scenes.text: The timeline is desperate to heal itself, accelerating time to consume anything near the missing core.
scenes.caption: Time is accelerating violently
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi looking at his own hands as they rapidly age and revert to childhood proportions.

scenes.text: Mira collapses, unable to hold her form as the vortex pulls the child toward the dark center.
scenes.caption: Mira loses her stability
scenes.image_prompt: Mira kneeling, her holographic teal coat dissolving into blue light as the child floats toward the rift.

scenes.text: Kavi realizes the hole demands a soul, not a battery, to anchor this broken, bleeding reality.
scenes.caption: Kavi finds the solution
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi, wearing glasses and a red backpack, staring intently into the swirling, dark temporal vortex.

scenes.text: He looks back once, seeing his own suppressed memories fading into the light of the saved child.
scenes.caption: Kavi makes his choice
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi turning his head back toward a fading Mira, his face showing a mix of sorrow and resolve.

scenes.text: Kavi leaps into the void, his physical form disintegrating into the engine that powers the dying timeline.
scenes.caption: Kavi becomes the engine
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi jumping into a massive, swirling vortex of red and black light, leaving behind a glowing trail.
